hint: planeMarks.arcs: {id,circle:CIRCLE node,center,from,to,side:MINOR|MAJOR|CCW|CW,label?}; from and to must lie on the circle; a half circle needs side CCW or CW. planeMarks.facts: ON_CIRCLE {circle (displayed),points} and TANGENT_PERPENDICULAR {center,contact,tangent: displayed line or segment id}. Every mark id is new (not a node, segment or other mark id); only the documented keys are allowed; every point a mark names must be displayed.

The independent plane-marks observer found a mark that does not match the points or the drawing. Fix the plan (the fact or the construction); a label it cannot place without overlap needs a larger figure, a callout (planeMarks.callouts) that pulls it out on a leader, or noLabel on the second angle of an equal pair.
